game.title: Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War

roadmap.title: Veteran campaign run
roadmap.description: Play the campaign once on Veteran, choosing the Truth ending, and pick up the mission-specific achievements and both side missions on the way.

roadmap.title: Mission replays
roadmap.description: Replay Break on Through on Recruit for the Disobey Adler route, and replay Identity Crisis for the Lie ending.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer
roadmap.description: Work through the five Multiplayer goals together; match wins take the longest.

roadmap.title: Zombies on Die Maschine
roadmap.description: Earn the Die Maschine achievements, grind Aetherium for perk upgrades, then craft every workbench item in one match.

roadmap.title: Dead Ops Arcade
roadmap.description: Play Dead Ops Arcade Solo Advanced Start to reach round 64 and collect the other four on the way.

achievements.description: Complete the Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play through the final mission of either ending. Side missions are not needed.

achievements.description: Complete the Campaign on Veteran or Realism difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat the campaign on Veteran or Realism.

steps.text: Start the campaign on Veteran. Realism is not needed.
After the first mission, pick the skills @item{Survivor} (+25% Health) and @item{Dependable} (-30% damage while standing still).
Stay in cover and let your health regenerate after a hit. The two side missions are optional on this run.

achievements.description: Complete Nowhere Left to Run in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Nowhere Left to Run.

steps.text: Play @loc{Nowhere Left to Run} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Fracture Jaw in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Fracture Jaw.

steps.text: Play @loc{Fracture Jaw} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Brick in the Wall in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Brick in the Wall.

steps.text: Play @loc{Brick in the Wall} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Redlight, Greenlight in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Redlight, Greenlight.

steps.text: Play @loc{Redlight, Greenlight} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Echoes of a Cold War in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Echoes of a Cold War.

steps.text: Play @loc{Echoes of a Cold War} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Desperate Measures in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Desperate Measures.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desperate Measures} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete End of the Line in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission End of the Line.

steps.text: Play @loc{End of the Line} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Break on Through in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Break on Through.

steps.text: Play @loc{Break on Through} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete The Final Countdown in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission The Final Countdown.

guide.context: This is one of two endings. If you chose the other one first, replay Identity Crisis and pick [TRUTH].

steps.text: In the final dialogue of @loc{Identity Crisis}, choose [TRUTH].
Play @loc{The Final Countdown} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Ashes to Ashes in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign mission Ashes to Ashes.

guide.context: This is one of two endings. If you chose the other one first, replay Identity Crisis and pick [LIE].

steps.text: In the final dialogue of @loc{Identity Crisis}, choose [LIE].
Play @loc{Ashes to Ashes} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Operation Chaos in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the side mission Operation Chaos.

guide.context: The floppy disc and the evidence do not matter for this.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation Chaos} when it unlocks. It is the top mission on the quest board.
If you skipped it, replay @loc{Cuba Briefing} and pick it from the board.

achievements.description: Complete Operation Red Circus in Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the side mission Operation Red Circus.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation Red Circus} when it unlocks. It is the bottom mission on the quest board.
If you skipped it, replay @loc{Cuba Briefing} and pick it from the board.
Pick any three suspects. Wrong picks still count.

achievements.description: Knock down 15 metal targets on Main Street in Redlight, Greenlight.
achievements.summary: Shoot down 15 metal targets in the Main Street area of Redlight, Greenlight.

guide.context: Enemies attack in this area.

steps.text: In @loc{Redlight, Greenlight}, reach the objective "Advance down Main Street".
Shoot 15 of the white metal targets with a red dot (some move), then continue. There are more than 15.

achievements.description: Perform Body Shield five times.
achievements.summary: Use the Body Shield on enemies five times in the campaign.

steps.text: Hold the takedown button next to an enemy. A short tap does a normal takedown instead.
Repeat five times. The count stays after a checkpoint restart.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with the bow while ziplining in Echoes of a Cold War.
achievements.summary: Shoot an enemy with the bow during the zipline ride in Echoes of a Cold War.

guide.context: The aim shakes a lot on the zipline.

steps.text: In @loc{Echoes of a Cold War}, take the bow after the first group of enemies in the dark corridor and keep it.
At the objective "Reach the Server", ride the zipline with the bow equipped and shoot one of the two enemies at the end.
If you miss, restart the checkpoint before you reach the end of the zipline. The next checkpoint is created after it.

achievements.description: See all seven memory endings and play through all four path ends in Break on Through.
achievements.summary: See all seven memory endings and finish all four path ends of Break on Through.

guide.context: You need two playthroughs of this mission: one obeying Adler, one disobeying him. Each has four parts. Play the disobey run on Recruit so you can run past enemies. Mission Select lets you replay the mission after the campaign.

steps.text: Turn on subtitles (Settings > Interface > Subtitles) so you can follow Adler's orders.

Obey run, part 1: pick up the M16 from the dead soldier at the start and kill the enemies. At the ruins go right. After the next group go right again and enter the cave entrance a little to the left. Go to the red door at the end of the cave.
Obey run, part 2: shoot the first enemies with the bow. At the ruins go left, cross the bridge, then go right. Clear the village. Once the helicopter has blown a wall open, go through the red door.

Obey run, part 3: use the grenade launcher or M16 at the start. At the ruins go left, cross the bridge and go left. Snipe the enemies and call in the napalm strike to reveal the red door in the ruined building. Enter it, follow the corridor and pick any file on the computer.
Obey run, part 4: enter the red door standing in the middle of the ruins. The popup "Disciple: Followed all of Adler's Orders" confirms the run.
Disobey run, part 1: pick up no weapon and run past the enemies. At the ruins go left, cross the bridge and go right. Fight through the village and enter the red door.

Disobey run, part 2: let the enemies see you, then run to the ruins. Go left, cross the bridge and go left. Kill the enemies, call in the napalm strike and enter the red door in the ruined house. In the corridor, interact with every window on the left, then sit in the doctor's chair.

Disobey run, part 3: run past the enemies. At the ruins go left, cross the bridge, then come back over it and take the zipline. Go right, open the wooden lid in the ground and climb down the ladder. Follow the dark tunnel until a zombie kills you. Go through the red doors and sit in the doctor's chair in the room with many screens.
Disobey run, part 4: the game skips to the ruins and the achievement should unlock. If it does not, go up the left path and use the zipline without entering the red door.

achievements.description: Kill 12 enemies with explosive barrels while riding the server lift during Echoes of a Cold War.
achievements.summary: Use explosive barrels to kill 12 enemies during the server lift ride in Echoes of a Cold War.

guide.context: Roughly 15 barrel kills are available, so a single mistake is fine. Playing on an easier difficulty helps. If a barrel got away from you, retry from the last checkpoint, which sits late in the ride.

steps.text: In @loc{Echoes of a Cold War}, attach the cable to the server at the objective "Attach Cable to the Server". The lift rises and enemies appear on all sides.
Shoot only the red explosive barrels so the blasts kill the enemies. Shooting enemies yourself does not count.
Finish the mission. The achievement unlocks only after the level ends.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies with the AC-130 while defending the rooftop in End of the Line.
achievements.summary: Get 25 AC-130 kills during the rooftop defence in End of the Line.

guide.context: The unlock appears a few seconds after the plane sequence. If you fail, the mission has to be replayed unless you backed up your save before the rooftop.

steps.text: In @loc{End of the Line}, survive the final rooftop defence.
Do not shoot enemies on the other roofs first. Dead enemies cannot be killed again with the plane.
When the AC-130 prompt appears, press it. Switch between rockets and minigun with the weapon-switch button.
Kill 25 enemies in the short time you have.

achievements.description: Disobey Adler’s order to go through the door in Break on Through.
achievements.summary: Refuse Adler's order to enter the red door during Break on Through.

guide.context: Your choices in the first three parts do not matter. This fits the end of the disobey run for Mind Trip.

steps.text: In @loc{Break on Through}, reach the fourth part. The game skips ahead and Adler tells you to skip to the next part.
Skip the red door in the bunker. Go down the left path to the bridge and walk around every other red door.
A red door blocks the bridge. Leave it alone and wait right in front of it. After about 15 seconds you get teleported away.

achievements.description: Get five kills each with an LMG, SMG, AR, and Shotgun.
achievements.summary: Get five campaign kills each with an LMG, an SMG, an assault rifle and a shotgun.

steps.text: Use each of the four weapon types during the story. The story hands out each type, and you can also take them from enemies.

achievements.description: Kill 200 enemies with an AR.
achievements.summary: Kill 200 enemies with assault rifles in the campaign.

steps.text: Use assault rifles such as the AK-47 or M16 for your kills. Replay any mission if you fall short; the count keeps going.

achievements.description: Destroy all enemy vehicles and mortar teams while defending Firebase Ripcord in Fracture Jaw.
achievements.summary: Wipe out every enemy vehicle and mortar crew attacking Firebase Ripcord in Fracture Jaw.

steps.text: In @loc{Fracture Jaw}, reach Firebase Ripcord and the objective "Provide Fire Support".
Before touching a vehicle, circle the base and spot the thin white smoke trails among the trees. Rocket all 5 mortar camps first.
Then destroy all 11 sets of vehicles marked with white markers. Fire a full barrage at each so none survive.

achievements.description: Blow up all trucks and guard towers on the approach to the monastery in The Final Countdown.
achievements.summary: Destroy every truck and guard tower along the approach road to the monastery during The Final Countdown.

guide.context: The unlock can take up to a minute to appear. If nothing appears, restart the mission.

steps.text: Choose [TRUTH] in @loc{Identity Crisis} to reach @loc{The Final Countdown}.
At the start, use the grenade launcher you receive during the truck drive. Destroy 4 trucks and 6 watch towers.
Order: 2 towers on the road (the left one falls on its own), truck left, truck right, truck left, truck right, 2 more towers, then 2 towers at the end of the road before the cutscene.
If you miss one, restart the checkpoint or the mission.

achievements.description: Get 200 Eliminations in Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Get 200 kills in Multiplayer.

steps.text: Play any Multiplayer matches. It comes with the other Multiplayer achievements. Track it in Multiplayer > Barracks > Combat Record.

achievements.description: Get 10 squad wipe medals in Fireteam.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 Squad Wipe medals while playing Fireteam.

steps.text: Play Fireteam. The Medals menu that tracks this unlocks at Multiplayer level 10.
Be the one who kills the last survivor of an enemy squad that still had 3 or more players. Each such kill gives one medal.
Check the count under Multiplayer, Barracks, Medals, then Game Modes and Squad Wipe.

achievements.description: Get 100 Kills as the driver, pilot, or passenger of a vehicle in Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Score 100 kills while driving, flying or riding in a vehicle in Multiplayer.

guide.context: Expect 5 to 20 matches.

steps.text: Queue for Fireteam Dirty Bomb or Combined Arms Moshpit and use tanks. Playlists rotate, so use whichever is available.
Track progress in Multiplayer > Barracks > Medals > Combat > Weapons Hot.

achievements.description: Win 50 matches of Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Win 50 matches of Multiplayer.

guide.context: Expect about 16 hours at 10 minutes per match with half of them won.

steps.text: Play any match type and win 50. Team modes such as Kill Confirmed suit weaker players: pick up dog tags. Deathmatch is quicker for strong players.
Check your wins in Multiplayer > Barracks > Combat Record, in the "Victory & Defeat" section.

achievements.description: Get 50 kills with lethal Scorestreaks in Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Score 50 kills using lethal Scorestreaks in Multiplayer.

steps.text: Equip the RC-XD and Sentry Turret in Multiplayer > Loadout > Scorestreaks.
Place turrets high where they overlook the map and are hard to reach. Earn the streaks through objectives and kills.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, forge the Pack-A-Punch machine.
achievements.summary: Forge the Pack-a-Punch machine in Die Maschine.

steps.text: In @loc{Die Maschine}, follow the white waypoints. Turn on the power first: follow the blue arrows on the walls underground.
After turning on the power, use both consoles in the same area.
Hold interact on a purple portal to be sent briefly to a dream world. Pick up the marked Pack-a-Punch piece there and carry it back to the power room.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, free the lost Decompressive Isotopic Estrangement Machine.
achievements.summary: Free the D.I.E. wonder weapon in Die Maschine.

guide.context: A good method is to bring a horde from the yard, switch on the trap and walk through the wind. It costs a little health.

steps.text: Kill the first @enemy{Megaton}. It spawns between rounds 6 and 10. Kill both halves after it splits. The second half drops a yellow keycard.
Bring the keycard to the Weapons Lab and use the machine with the cracked glass in the corner. Take the D.I.E. Remote Control from the shelf that opens.
In the @loc{Living Room} on the ground floor of the start building, hold interact to place the remote in the marked wall.
Use the "D.I.E. Turn on remotely" prompt to start the wind trap. Get 20 zombie kills with it. You can reactivate it after its cooldown.
When the door to the remote room opens, pick up the D.I.E. wonder weapon.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, close the rift.
achievements.summary: Close the rift in Die Maschine.

guide.context: This is the main Easter Egg of Die Maschine.

steps.text: Play the Die Maschine main quest to its end: build the aetheroscope, then get the D.I.E. Shockwave and its four upgrades.
Capture Orlov in the purification capsule, then destroy the accelerator and run to the pond to escape.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, kill the two split Megatons with one shot.
achievements.summary: Kill the two split Megaton halves with one shot in Die Maschine.

steps.text: Get the D.I.E. Shockwave first (Carpe D.I.E.M.).
Kill a @enemy{Megaton}. One spawns between rounds 6 and 10 and another between rounds 11 and 15.
Wait until the halves finish splitting, because they cannot be hurt during it. When they stand close together, fire the Shockwave at them. One shot kills both.

achievements.description: In Zombies, upgrade a skill.
achievements.summary: Upgrade one Field Upgrade in Zombies.

steps.text: Survive round 10 in a Zombies match to earn 1 Aetherium. Another comes after round 15.
From the title screen open Zombies > Loadout > Field Upgrades and buy the first upgrade of any one.

achievements.description: In Zombies, upgrade 6 Perk Skills to Tier III.
achievements.summary: Raise six Perk Skills to Tier III in Zombies.

guide.context: About 18 matches of 20 to 25 minutes each.

steps.text: Reach the start of round 16 in a match, then let the zombies kill you. Each match pays 2 Aetherium (1 after round 10, 1 after round 15).

Open Zombies, then Loadout, Skills and Perks. Raise six perks to Tier III: Quick Revive, Jugger-Nog, Speed Cola, Deadshot Daiquiri, Elemental Pop and Stamin-Up. Tiers cost 1, 2 and 3 Aetherium, so 36 in all.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, kill 100 enemies without leaving the top of the crashed plane wing.
achievements.summary: Get 100 kills in Die Maschine while staying on top of the crashed plane wing.

guide.context: Teammates' kills count if they are on the wing too.

steps.text: Get the D.I.E. Shockwave first (Carpe D.I.E.M.). It never runs out of ammo.
Walk to the @loc{Crash Site}, to the right of the Yard, and climb the plane wing. Stand at the tip.
Kill 100 enemies without stepping off. Zombies can climb the sides but not from behind. Check the count with the scoreboard button.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, stay in the Yard for 15 rounds.
achievements.summary: Survive 15 rounds without leaving the Yard in Die Maschine.

steps.text: Pick a starting class with a shotgun or machine gun. The Containment class (Hauer 77) is easiest.
Do not open any door or leave the @loc{Yard} for 15 rounds. Keep running in circles and shoot the zombies in front of you.
In co-op, tell the others not to open doors.

achievements.description: In Die Maschine, craft 14 different types of items in one match.
achievements.summary: Craft all 14 workbench item types in one Die Maschine match.

guide.context: Expect to reach a high round. Co-op makes it easier because you can revive each other.

steps.text: Reach player level 54 first. Self-Revive is locked until then.
Pick up the green and blue scrap that zombies drop. Higher rounds drop more blue.
At a crafting table (one is in the Yard), hold interact to see the 14 items, and craft every one in the same match.

achievements.description: Get a chain of 5 chickens strung together in Dead Ops Arcade.
achievements.summary: Have five chickens following you at once in Dead Ops Arcade.

guide.context: It is luck-based.

steps.text: Open power-up crates until a 5-chicken power-up drops, or collect single chickens from several crates in a row.
Dungeons hold many crates, so they are a good place to try.

achievements.description: Escape from the deep dark Wild.
achievements.summary: Complete the Round 4 area called The Wild in Dead Ops Arcade.

steps.text: From the title screen choose Zombies, then Dead Ops Arcade in a public, private or solo game. Play through Round 4 and leave the area. The achievement unlocks as you exit.

achievements.description: Defeat the Mamaback and save your dear friend.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Momaback boss in Round 64 of Dead Ops Arcade.

guide.context: You start with 3 lives. When a round begins and you hold no nukes, you are given 1 for free. Co-op is a bad idea, because a game over in co-op restarts you at round 1. Plan for 3 to 8 hours.

steps.text: On the title screen go to Solo and pick Dead Ops Arcade Solo Advanced Start.
When you die, choose this mode again and wait at the spawn. It takes you to the highest world you reached.
Keep playing to Round 64 and defeat the @enemy{Momaback}.

achievements.description: Find your destiny in the Room of Fate.
achievements.summary: Finish Round 20 in Dead Ops Arcade by touching a Fate Stone.

steps.text: From the title screen choose Zombies, then Dead Ops Arcade. Play to the end of Round 20 and touch any Fate Stone.

achievements.description: Visit every corner of a Deadly Dungeon.
achievements.summary: Visit every corner of a dungeon in Dead Ops Arcade.

guide.context: Dungeons are random and can take about 10 minutes.

steps.text: Enter the first dungeon in the top left corner of Round 4, The Wild.
Walk through every area until the whole minimap changes colour.
Do not leave by the golden ladder until you finish. You cannot re-enter that dungeon in the same match.
